payload.abstract: MIMIC-IV-ED is a publicly accessible database of over 400,000 emergency department (ED) admissions to the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2011 and 2019. Access to MIMIC-IV-ED requires registration on PhysioNet, identity verification, completion of human participant training, and signing of a data use agreement. Here, we have provided an openly available demo of MIMIC-IV-ED containing a subset of 100 patients. Being a derivative dataset, the MIMIC-IV-ED demo is deidentified according to the same standard as MIMIC-IV-ED. The demo is intended to support workshops, educational material, exploration of MIMIC-IV-ED, and other aims enabled by an openly available dataset.
